# Live2D Web Core

`live2dcubismcore.min.js` was downloaded from the official Cubism 5.2 hosted Core:
https://cubism.live2d.com/sdk-web/core/05/live2dcubismcore.min.js

Official download and license information:
https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/download/web/

The runtime is loaded locally when the AI assistant opens. Keep the original
copyright header. Model files live separately in `public/hiyori_vts`.
